verdict.rationale: The docs publish a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document for the Agent Server, the LangGraph Platform runtime. It covers assistants, threads, runs, crons, store, A2A, MCP and system endpoints, is listed under "OpenAPI Specs" in llms.txt, and the control plane serves its own spec. The probe's 404s at generic well-known paths do not contradict the spec published at its documented path. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the spec download, a spec at a discoverable well-known path, and a spec for the open-source library itself rather than only the Agent Server and deployment layer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: docs.langchain.com publishes the Agent Server (LangGraph Platform runtime) OpenAPI 3.1 document
the deployment control plane serves its own spec at https://api.host.langchain.com/openapi.json
every deployed or locally run Agent Server ships a built-in interactive API docs endpoint
